title: Turing asks "Can machines think?"
description: Alan Turing's paper 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' proposes the imitation game, later known as the Turing test.

title: The term "artificial intelligence" is born
description: The Dartmouth summer workshop brings researchers together and gives the field its name.

title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
description: IBM's chess computer defeats the reigning world champion in a six-game match.

title: Deep learning takes off
description: The AlexNet neural network wins the ImageNet image-recognition competition by a wide margin, kick-starting the deep learning boom.

title: AlphaGo wins at Go
description: DeepMind's AlphaGo beats Lee Sedol, one of the world's best Go players, a feat many expected to be a decade away.

title: The Transformer
description: The paper 'Attention Is All You Need' introduces the Transformer architecture that modern LLMs are built on.

title: ChatGPT goes public
description: OpenAI releases ChatGPT and conversational AI reaches a mass audience almost overnight.
